status: AI-assisted selection; principles confirmed by project researcher on 2026-09-30
selection_method: Purposeful functional selection with explicit complementary checks and individually documented reserve decisions; qualitative researcher judgments remain necessary

selection_rules.S1: Selected: directly supports a decision arising from the stated relationship or manipulated cue.
selection_rules.S2: Selected: adds a distinct recipient action, exposure boundary or operational function tied to that decision, ongoing messaging, identity checking or the contemplated first meeting.
selection_rules.S3: Selected: supplies an enabling precaution, interpretation limit or response to a proposed check/action; check and caveat share the same availability condition.
selection_rules.R1: Reserve: a narrower implementation or alternative wording of selected actions. Record the comparator and residual distinction; this is not semantic duplicate deletion.
selection_rules.R2: Reserve: a distinct background configuration, broad educational, service-selection or general in-person task outside the defined relationship/checking/meeting decision functions. Not claimed fully covered.
selection_rules.R3: Reserve: requires an additional transaction role, event, person, baseline, population or downstream administrative task not stated or needed for a selected action. Not claimed fully covered.
selection_rules.R4: Reserve: supporter/adviser delivery principle. All eleven follow the same role rule; supportive tone remains a generation instruction.

stopping_rule: Review every eligible item once; retain all judged S1/S2/S3 functions and their necessary companions; reserve R1/R2/R3/R4. No count target or claimed mathematical optimum.
human_validation: The project researcher confirmed the current selection principles on 30 September 2026, accepting the 60-selected/60-reserve framework for subsequent API generation. This records principle-level approval, not independent double coding or new source verification.
legacy_batch: The September 27 v2 batch used 53 references and is not relabeled as v3
human_writers: Unaided ordinary adults; main comparison is reference-supported AI versus unaided human advice, not equal information or intrinsic ability
